items.q: What should you remember about **Slow brain → slow mouth**?
items.a: **processing lag causes real-time** formulation failure; both halves need separate drills.

items.q: What should you remember about **Speed without articulation = mumble**?
items.a: **tongue twisters trip you** up on purpose; clarity and velocity train together.

items.q: What should you remember about **WPM is measurable**?
items.a: **300-word story at 1** minute gives baseline; intentional +10 WPM increments track progress.

items.q: What should you remember about **Breathy = slow**?
items.a: **too much air per** word exhausts breath supply; "ease out" air, don't push it.

items.q: What should you remember about **One breath, many words**?
items.a: **controlled support lets you** speak long stretches without gasping.

items.q: What should you remember about **Understanding beats retrieval**?
items.a: **new hires in a field** stall because they search memory instead of reasoning from depth.

items.q: What should you remember about **Depth + framework**?
items.a: **expertise alone overwhelms; 321** framework prevents tab-overload when answering loaded questions.

items.q: What should you remember about **One thing > everything**?
items.a: **give one powerful answer; let follow-ups request more.**

items.q: What should you remember about **Anxiety taxes cognition**?
items.a: **box breathing before stressful** conversations clears the mind for faster thinking.
